answer: Collateralized trust-graph vouching deters Sybil accounts by requiring each newcomer to bond stake and earn capacity-limited peer endorsements. Verifiers run max-flow audits from trusted anchors so narrow cut edges cap any isolated cluster's weight. Attackers therefore lock per-identity collateral and consume scarce vouch capacity. Yet honest newcomers far from anchors, like relays on a glacier ledge or agents translating a sonnet, face steep onboarding barriers.
